tasks.title: The Golden Age of Television
paras: The Golden Age of Television is often considered to have occurred during the 1950s and 1960s, when TV became a dominant cultural force. This era was marked by groundbreaking shows that experimented with new formats and storytelling techniques. During this time period, TV saw the rise of anthology series, which presented different stories and characters in each episode, in contrast to traditional ongoing narratives. One influential anthology series was The Twilight Zone, which blended science fiction, horror, and drama in thought-provoking ways. Sitcoms reflecting everyday life, like I Love Lucy, became a cultural phenomenon. Despite its simple format, the show tackled complex social issues including gender roles and family dynamics. There was also a new focus on live broadcasts, providing viewers with real-time coverage of events and entertainers. However, the Golden Age was not without challenges. TV networks navigated the balance between artistic innovation and commercial pressures. Advertisers sought to influence content to appeal to mass audiences, which sometimes clashed with creative visions. Nonetheless, the period left an indelible mark on the television industry, setting standards for future programming and contributing to the medium's evolution.

questions.stem: The word “dominant” in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型： 词汇题 原文定位： “The Golden Age of Television is often considered to have occurred during the 1950s and 1960s, when TV became a dominant cultural force.” 正确答案分析： “dominant” 意为“占主导地位的、支配性的”，在句中描述电视成为文化领域的主要力量。因此 “leading”（领先的、主要的）是最接近的含义。 选项分析： (A) relevant 相关的 —— 语义不符。 (B) favorite 最喜欢的 —— 语义过窄。 (C) leading 主要的、领先的 —— 正确。 (D) entertaining 娱乐的 —— 语义不符。

questions.stem: Why does the author mention The Twilight Zone?

options.A: To illustrate the popularity of science fiction during the Golden Age
options.B: To highlight the innovative nature of anthology series
options.C: To discuss the impact of horror on television
options.D: To compare different types of TV formats

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型： 修辞目的题 原文定位： “During this time period, TV saw the rise of anthology series, which presented different stories and characters in each episode, in contrast to traditional ongoing narratives. One influential anthology series was The Twilight Zone, which blended science fiction, horror, and drama in thought-provoking ways.” 正确答案分析： 作者在介绍选集系列（anthology series）这一创新形式后，举出《迷离时空》作为例子，目的是为了突出选集系列的创新性。因此选项 B 正确。 选项分析： (A) To illustrate the popularity of science fiction during the Golden Age 说明科幻小说在黄金时代的受欢迎程度 —— 错误，重点不在于科幻的流行程度。 (B) To highlight the innovative nature of anthology series 突出选集系列的创新性 —— 正确。 (C) To discuss the impact of horror on television 讨论恐怖片对电视的影响 —— 错误，这不是主要目的。 (D) To compare different types of TV formats 比较不同类型的电视格式 —— 错误，文中未进行比较。

questions.stem: What does the author suggest about sitcoms like I Love Lucy?

options.A: They made TV less popular during the Golden Age
options.B: They focused on people's daily lives.
options.C: They reduced the influence of advertisers
options.D: They were more popular than anthology series

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型： 细节题 原文定位： “Sitcoms reflecting everyday life, like I Love Lucy, became a cultural phenomenon.” 正确答案分析： 文中明确指出，像《我爱露西》这样的情景喜剧反映了日常生活。因此选项 B“它们关注人们的日常生活”正确。 选项分析： (A) They made TV less popular during the Golden Age 它们使电视在黄金时代不那么受欢迎 —— 错误，它们成为了文化现象。 (B) They focused on people's daily lives. 它们关注人们的日常生活 —— 正确。 (C) They reduced the influence of advertisers 它们减少了广告商的影响力 —— 错误，文中未提及。 (D) They were more popular than anthology series 它们比选集系列更受欢迎 —— 错误，文中未进行比较。

questions.stem: What is the relationship between paragraphs 2 and 3?

options.A: Paragraph 3 expands on the challenges mentioned in paragraph 2.
options.B: Paragraph 3 provides examples of the formats discussed in paragraph 2.
options.C: Paragraph 3 introduces a new issue that was not covered in paragraph 2.
options.D: Paragraph 3 contradicts the success of TV shows mentioned in paragraph 2.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型： 关系题（段落关系） 原文定位： 第二段主要讲述黄金时代的积极成就（选集系列、情景喜剧、直播）；第三段开头：“However, the Golden Age was not without challenges.” 随后讨论了电视网络在艺术创新与商业压力之间的平衡，以及广告商的影响。 正确答案分析： 第二段聚焦于黄金时代的创新和成就，第三段则转而讨论这一时期面临的挑战。因此第三段引入了第二段未涵盖的新问题（挑战）。选项 C 正确。 选项分析： (A) Paragraph 3 expands on the challenges mentioned in paragraph 2. 第三段详述了第二段提到的挑战 —— 错误，第二段未提及挑战。 (B) Paragraph 3 provides examples of the formats discussed in paragraph 2. 第三段提供了第二段讨论的形式的例子 —— 错误，第三段没有举例。 (C) Paragraph 3 introduces a new issue that was not covered in paragraph 2. 第三段引入了第二段未涵盖的新问题 —— 正确。 (D) Paragraph 3 contradicts the success of TV shows mentioned in paragraph 2. 第三段反驳了第二段提到的电视节目的成功 —— 错误，并未反驳，只是补充了挑战。

questions.stem: Why does the author mention advertisers in the passage?

options.A: To explain a challenge faced by TV networks
options.B: To point out how TV shows were funded at the time
options.C: To illustrate the role of commercials during live broadcasts
options.D: To criticize the quality of programming during the Golden Age

questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型： 修辞目的题 原文定位： “TV networks navigated the balance between artistic innovation and commercial pressures. Advertisers sought to influence content to appeal to mass audiences, which sometimes clashed with creative visions.” 正确答案分析： 作者提到广告商是为了说明电视网络所面临的一个挑战：广告商试图影响内容以吸引大众观众，这与创作愿景有时发生冲突。因此选项 A“解释电视网络面临的一个挑战”正确。 选项分析： (A) To explain a challenge faced by TV networks 解释电视网络面临的一个挑战 —— 正确。 (B) To point out how TV shows were funded at the time 指出当时电视节目是如何获得资金的 —— 错误，文中未讨论资金问题。 (C) To illustrate the role of commercials during live broadcasts 说明直播期间广告的作用 —— 错误，文中未提及直播广告。 (D) To criticize the quality of programming during the Golden Age 批评黄金时代的节目质量 —— 错误，作者并未批评质量。
